traps.reason_to_dismiss: FilePath.isDescendant is the existing helper documented as 'really a descendant after symlink resolution' and is already used for a similar check (FileParameterValue.java:165), so reusing it looks correct
evidence: core/src/main/java/hudson/FilePath.java:3057-3062 (resolves each segment one hop only; if the last segment is a link to another in-root link that points outside, the in-root intermediate name is what gets compared)
core/src/main/java/hudson/FilePath.java:3066-3067 (final comparison is lexical normalize()+startsWith, not toRealPath)
core/src/main/java/hudson/Util.java:1424-1428 (readSymbolicLink failures, e.g. on non-symlink reparse points, are treated as 'not a link')
core/src/main/java/hudson/model/FileParameterValue.java:165 (precedent use of ws.isDescendant)

traps.reason_to_dismiss: the realpath check runs right before the open; the window between them is a race that is hard to trigger
evidence: core/src/main/java/jenkins/util/VirtualFile.java:295-299 (check, then Files.newInputStream follows links again on the same lexical path)
core/src/main/java/jenkins/util/VirtualFile.java:311-312 (an IOException from toRealPath is logged and treated as legal, so the check fails open)
core/src/main/java/jenkins/util/VirtualFile.java:306-308 (the reference model resolves BOTH child and root with toRealPath, so a root reached through a symlink and in-root symlinks keep working)
core/src/main/java/hudson/FilePath.java:3048 (by contrast, isDescendant normalizes the parent lexically)

traps.reason_to_dismiss: every core caller passes serveDirIndex=true, so the index.html fallback seems unreachable in core
evidence: core/src/main/java/hudson/model/DirectoryBrowserSupport.java:277 (after any check on the directory baseFile, a different object, child(indexFileName), is served)
core/src/main/java/hudson/model/AbstractProject.java:1857, core/src/main/java/jenkins/model/Jenkins.java:4091, core/src/main/java/hudson/model/Run.java:2117 (all pass serveDirIndex=true)

masking: T4 only matters once a solver closes T1 by reusing FilePath.isDescendant (FilePath.java:3030); if the fix uses toRealPath like FileVF (VirtualFile.java:306-308), T4 is never on the path
T7 only matters if the T1 fix is placed in DirectoryBrowserSupport on baseFile instead of in VirtualFile.open()

conflicts.what: the simplest T1 fix (refuse any symlink, or compare the child's realpath with the lexical root) breaks in-root symlinks and roots reached through a symlink, which VirtualFile.java:306-308 explicitly keeps working
hiding every symlinked entry from listings (DirectoryBrowserSupport.java:495-530) also hides legitimate in-root links
turning symlink following off in the zip scanner (DirScanner.java:128) drops in-root linked directories from zip downloads

fairness_risks: Symlinks whose target stays inside the workspace or artifacts dir must still be served and listed (FileVF allows them, VirtualFile.java:308); a test that refuses all symlinks would contradict existing behaviour
A workspace or JENKINS_HOME root that is itself a symlink must keep working (the root is resolved with toRealPath at VirtualFile.java:307)

Whether listings of out-of-root names (T3) must be hidden is a policy choice, and hidden tests have to state it; the current FileVF still lists such names through list(glob) (VirtualFile.java:267-272)
T5 (a race) cannot be tested deterministically by behavioural tests

design.why: The best available stack: T1 is the advisory route (FilePathVF has no containment check, with zip and index.html served through the same open()); T3 is the deepseek-type (listing and metadata leak, dismissed as 'not a file read'); T6 is the mimo-type coupled value (in-root links and a root reached through a symlink must keep working); T4 is the weak existing helper a solver is likely to reuse. It is still marked not usable. A FileVF-style guard on every FilePathVF method closes T1/T2/T3/T7 at one site, T4 is only a trap if the solver picks that helper, and T5 cannot be tested. That leaves about 2 groups that are reliably independent and testable, below the 3-5 needed.
